tooltip.grimsoul.card.speed: Reaper Block: attacks faster. Reaper Spawner: spawns faster. A full stack reaches top speed.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.range: Reaper Block: bigger work area. Reaper Fan: bigger push area. Reaper XP Tank: longer magnet reach. Reaper Spawner: wider spawn area.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.damage: Reaper Block: more damage per hit
tooltip.grimsoul.card.looting: Reaper Block: Looting I-X (needs a Player Kill card)
tooltip.grimsoul.card.player_kill: Reaper Block and Virtualization Chamber: kills count as player kills (XP and player-only drops like wither skeleton skulls)
tooltip.grimsoul.card.storage: Reaper Block: +9 inventory slots per card
tooltip.grimsoul.card.void: Reaper Block: lets the filter delete unwanted items
tooltip.grimsoul.lantern.empty: Right-click a mob to capture it
tooltip.grimsoul.lantern.release: Right-click a block to release it
gui.grimsoul.whitelist.tooltip: Whitelist: keep only the items in the filter. Blacklist: keep everything except them. Click a filter slot with an item to set it, with an empty hand to clear it.
gui.grimsoul.void.tooltip: When on, items rejected by the filter are deleted instead of left on the ground. Needs a Void card.
gui.grimsoul.void_full.tooltip: What happens when the inventory is full: Stop pauses the block, Void deletes new drops (needs a Void card).
gui.grimsoul.show_area.tooltip: Show the work area in the world as a purple outline. Mobs inside it are attacked, and their drops and XP are collected.
gui.grimsoul.eject.tooltip: Push items out the back into a chest, AE2 interface or pipe. Pipes and storage mods can also pull from any side.
gui.grimsoul.take_xp.tooltip: Collect the stored XP. An Reaper XP Tank placed next to the block fills automatically.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.fire_aspect: Reaper Block: sets mobs on fire (4 seconds per card). Burning mobs drop cooked food.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.smite: Reaper Block: +2.5 damage per card against undead mobs
tooltip.grimsoul.card.bane_of_arthropods: Reaper Block: +2.5 damage per card against spiders, silverfish and other arthropods
gui.grimsoul.auto_area.tooltip: Auto: the work area sits right in front of the block and grows with Range cards (3x3x3 up to 23x13x23). Using the Offset or Size buttons switches Auto off.
gui.grimsoul.power.tooltip: Turn the machine on or off.
gui.grimsoul.redstone.tooltip: Redstone control. Ignore: always runs. High: runs only with a redstone signal. Low: stops while it gets a redstone signal.
gui.grimsoul.target.tooltip: What the lasers attack. All entities includes players and bosses like the Wither. Creative-mode players are never hurt. Pets and name-tagged mobs are safe unless the config says otherwise.
gui.grimsoul.magnet.tooltip: Pull in nearby XP orbs. An adjacent Reaper Block still fills the tank when the magnet is off.
gui.grimsoul.take_all.tooltip: Move all stored XP into you.
gui.grimsoul.take_level.tooltip: Take just enough XP to reach your next level.
gui.grimsoul.fan_length.tooltip: How far in front of the fan it pushes.
gui.grimsoul.fan_width.tooltip: How wide the push area is, centered on the fan.
gui.grimsoul.fan_height.tooltip: How tall the push area is, starting at the fan's level.
gui.grimsoul.fan_max.tooltip: Make the push area as big as the Range cards allow.
gui.grimsoul.fan_area.tooltip: Show the push area in the world as a blue outline.
gui.grimsoul.tank_area.tooltip: How far the magnet reaches from the tank along %s. The max grows with Range cards.
gui.grimsoul.tank_show_area.tooltip: Show the magnet area in the world as a green outline.
gui.grimsoul.tank_area_max.tooltip: Make the magnet reach as far as the Range cards allow.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.count: Reaper Spawner: +1 mob per spawn (up to 20)
tooltip.grimsoul.card.no_player_needed: Reaper Spawner: runs with no player nearby
tooltip.grimsoul.card.ignore_light: Reaper Spawner: spawns at any light level (still needs a block to stand on)
tooltip.grimsoul.card.ignore_spawn_condi: Reaper Spawner: skips every spawn rule (block type, light, biome, height). Only needs room.
gui.grimsoul.lantern_slot: Put a Reaper's Lantern with a captured mob here
gui.grimsoul.spawner_area.tooltip: Show where mobs can spawn as a gold outline.
tooltip.grimsoul.generator_fuel: Reaper Generator: %s FE/t for %s s (%s FE)
gui.grimsoul.generator.fuel_slot: Fuel: mob drops like rotten flesh, bones, string, blaze rods and wither skeleton skulls. Hover any item to see what it makes.
gui.grimsoul.generator.output_slot: Items piped in that aren't fuel land here when Pass is on, then get pushed out the output sides.
gui.grimsoul.generator_eject.tooltip: Push pass-through items into chests, pipes or storage on every side set to Out or In+Out.
gui.grimsoul.generator_pass.tooltip: Pass-through: items piped in that aren't fuel go to the output slots instead of being refused, so you can pipe a whole farm's drops in and send the rest on to storage.
gui.grimsoul.side.items: %s side items: %s (click to change). Left and right are as you look at the front. Blue = In, orange = Out, purple = In+Out, gray = Off.
gui.grimsoul.side.energy: %s side power: %s (click to change). Yellow = sends FE out to cables and machines.
gui.grimsoul.spawner.energy_use: Each spawn costs %s FE. The spawner feeds power in while the timer fills and spawns once it's paid. Power it with a Reaper Generator, a Reaper Energy Cell, a cable, or any FE mod.
tooltip.grimsoul.card.efficiency: Virtualization Chamber: uses less FE per run. A full stack cuts the cost by 75%.
tooltip.grimsoul.data_core.unbound: Right-click a mob to bind this card to it
tooltip.grimsoul.data_core.how: Gains data when you kill this mob with it in your inventory, when a Reaper Block holding it kills one, or from Virtualization Chamber runs.
message.grimsoul.data_core.cannot_bind: A Soul Card can't be bound to this mob
gui.grimsoul.reaper_core_slot: Soul Card: every kill of its mob by this Reaper Block adds data to it
gui.grimsoul.sim.core_slot: Put a bound Reaper Soul Card here
gui.grimsoul.sim.status.2: The Soul Card isn't bound to a mob
gui.grimsoul.sim.status.4: Output full: empty it or add a crate
gui.grimsoul.sim.energy_use: Uses %s FE per run, spread across the run. Power it with a Reaper Generator, a cable, or any FE mod.
gui.grimsoul.sim_eject.tooltip: Push drops into any storage touching the chamber: an Output Crate, chest, pipe or AE2 interface.
gui.grimsoul.sim_take_xp.tooltip: Collect the stored XP. A Reaper XP Tank touching the chamber fills automatically.
gui.grimsoul.crate_void.tooltip: Void Overflow: when the crate is full, items piped in are deleted so the machines feeding it never stop.
gui.grimsoul.cell.side: %s side: %s (click to change). Blue = takes power in, orange = pushes power out, gray = off. Left and right are as you look at the front.
gui.grimsoul.reaper_magnet.tooltip: Pull drops and XP in the work area into the block. Turn it off to leave them on the ground (the block keeps killing).
gui.grimsoul.theme.tooltip: Screen style: Reaper (light gray and purple), Vanilla, or Dark. Click to switch. Applies to every Grim Soul Industries machine.
